profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc., also known as Digital Realty, is a public company traded under the ticker DLR and headquartered in Austin, Texas. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001297996. On its own site, the company describes itself as a provider of data center services and colocation, offering interconnection capabilities across a global ecosystem that includes data centers, connectivity and cloud services. It says it delivers what it calls the world's largest data center platform, serving deployments from single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows, and describes itself as built for flexibility, open ecosystems and broad reach.

On AI, the company says inference loads and GPU demands are pushing traditional environments to their limits, and frames AI as evolving faster than existing infrastructure. It points to its 2026 Global Data Insights Survey, which it says found that 40% of IT leaders cite infrastructure as an AI constraint, and describes enterprises moving from AI strategy to execution.

The company's recorded law exposure is in Texas, with 126 matters. No lawsuits, AI products or MCP servers appear in the material.
